title: A Letter About a Job
text:
Dear Mr. Silva, I am writing to ask about the job advertised on your website. I have three years of experience in customer service. I would like to know when the interview will take place.

Thank you for your time. Please reply to my email at the address above. I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.text: What job is the writer asking about?
options: The job advertised on the website

questions.text: How many years of experience does the writer have?
Why does the writer send this letter?
options: To invite the reader to dinner

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer's attitude?

vocabulary.definition: knowledge or skill gained from doing a job or activity over time
a formal meeting to ask someone questions about a job
described publicly to attract people, for example a job
to answer a letter, email or message

paragraph_translations: Шановний пане Сильво, пишу, щоб запитати про вакансію, оголошену на вашому сайті. Маю три роки досвіду роботи з обслуговування клієнтів. Хотів би дізнатися, коли відбудеться співбесіда.
Дякую за ваш час. Будь ласка, відповідайте на мій електронний лист за вказаною вище адресою. Із нетерпінням чекаю на вашу відповідь.
